relations: 叙述者 Ophelia 唤 Dante Inferno；他隔着 bond 感得到她受苦、感不到疼痛本身。
Jazz 和 River 送饭，Liv 和 Niall 送塔可和咖啡；她是监狱魔法的建造者，正亲手拆解它。
他守「你饿或疼时不从你吸血」的规矩；做爱结束 knot 会锁住两人。
章末她确信自己爱上了他（此前只是 falling in love）。

facts.fact: 几小时后 Jazz 和 River 给我们和随行人员送来食物。
facts.anchor: Jazz and River brought us and our entourage food a few hours later.

facts.fact: Dante 估拆解至少剩十二小时、更可能十五小时；就算不停也要到明天午饭时间。
facts.anchor: you have at least twelve hours left. Probably more like fifteen. With breaks, even if you don't stop

facts.fact: 他拍板再留两小时缩短明天时长，然后带我回家，并去通知 fae。
facts.anchor: Alright. We'll stay two more hours, so we're not here as long tomorrow.

facts.fact: 收工时我状态差到他又一次抱我上车。
facts.anchor: Dante had to carry me to the car again, by the time I was done.

facts.fact: 我挣开眼皮见 blackout 窗帘缝隙漏光，才意识到根本不是早晨。
facts.anchor: I wrestled my eyelids open and saw a few cracks of light leaking through the places the blackout curtains met

facts.fact: 我夺过他手机搜 ramen，城里跳出 a dozen 家餐厅，我们出门吃拉面。
facts.anchor: It only took a minute to search "ramen", and a dozen restaurants in the city popped up.

facts.fact: 车里他把尖牙咬进我喉咙，我的魔法四周盛开与他的影子交织。
facts.anchor: His fangs sank into my throat, flooding me with heat in the way only his bite could.

facts.fact: 一起到达顶点，knot 锁住身体；我确信自己爱上了他。
facts.anchor: his knot locking our bodies together. We held each other's gaze as we went over the edge.
